0022600237.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (10-2, 1st in the West and 1st in the Pacific, on a six-game winning streak) visit the Phoenix Suns (4-6, 11th in the West, 5 games back in the Pacific, and on a one-game winning streak) for this 14th game of the Lakers' season. Lakers guard Austin Reaves (heel, averaging 25.3 points this season) and Quentin Grimes (finger, averaging 8.0 points) are out, and Suns center Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) is also out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Lakers lost 2-3 to the Suns in the 2025-26 season, and the Lakers won the most recent meeting 101-73 in Los Angeles on April 10, 2026.
